verdicts.reason: Both get the hierarchy backwards: the subline 'food & drinks' is set much larger than the 'Order online' headline. Both also cram the headline into a tiny two-line stack and crop the packaging to unreadable slivers. A at least keeps a gap between the headline and 'food & drinks' and keeps a trace of the top rule. In B, 'online' butts right against 'food', so the two blocks read as one jammed cluster, and the rules are lost.
